summary: Run dev reconciliation-drift on the existing Postgres store like the control topology.

hosted_measurements.failure_symptom: incident listener unhealthy due to first tick taking ~30m to process oversized JSON ledger

operator_live_repair.action: The Postgres store starts empty and the operator archived the oversized JSON ledger on the dev volume on 2026-10-08 as a temporary live repair.
operator_live_repair.migration_policy: No code migrates or deletes the existing JSON files. Single mechanism matching control topology.

acceptance_verification.ac1_dev_compose_and_deploy_select_postgr: passed: docker-compose.yml defaults RECONCILIATION_DRIFT_STORE_BACKEND to postgres matching docker-compose.control.yml:657, and scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh exports RECONCILIATION_DRIFT_STORE_BACKEND=postgres and DSN for hosted dev deployment. The JSON file store is no longer the dev default.
acceptance_verification.ac2_postgres_dsn_non_admin_role: passed: Postgres DSN follows the standard non-admin pantheon_app owner-store pattern (postgresql://pantheon_app:pantheon_app@postgres:5432/pantheon). No new store class, second backend, or fallback was added.
acceptance_verification.ac3_fail_closed_test: passed: test_reconciliation_drift_compose_environment_builds_postgres_store_and_fails_closed_without_dsn in test_reconciliation_drift_compose_activation.py proves the service builds PostgresReconciliationDriftStore from the dev compose environment and fails closed with ValueError when DSN is missing without falling back to JSON.
acceptance_verification.ac4_no_json_migration_empty_store: passed: No code migrates or deletes existing JSON files. Evidence states Postgres store starts empty and operator archived oversized JSON files on 2026-10-08.
acceptance_verification.ac5_tests_and_loopback_postgres: passed: All 130 reconciliation-drift tests pass. Live Postgres test test_live_postgres_reconciliation_drift_store_loopback in test_reconciliation_drift_store.py runs against disposable loopback database when TEST_DATABASE_URL is set, or reports skipped with explicit reason when unset.
acceptance_verification.ac6_hosted_measurements_recorded: passed: Recorded hosted measurements (drift_evaluations 37MB, work_claims 24MB, drift_reports 10MB; incident listener first tick ~30 minutes against deploy health window of ~8 minutes; deploy run 37719887861 failed on reconciliation-drift-incident-listener unhealthy).

local_verification.result: passed: compose activation (2 passed), store tests (27 passed, 1 skipped for missing TEST_DATABASE_URL), deploy vm wiring test (1 passed), deploy vm dry run (1 passed), deploy script syntax check (passed).

recon_health_counts_followup.summary: Read reconciliation health counts without hydrating owner records via PostgresJsonOwnerStore.count and store count operations.
